literal: Harmful things those who did, punishing them is, they to feel ashamed, good kindness having done, to leave it.
translation: The way to punish those who have done harm to you is to make them feel ashamed by doing them a good turn and forgetting it.
modern: நமக்குத் துன்பம் செய்தவரைத் தண்டிப்பது என்பது, அவர் வெட்கப்படும்படியாக அவருக்கு நல்ல நன்மைகளைச் செய்துவிட்டு அதனை மறந்துவிடுவது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the ultimate way to respond to those who cause us harm. Instead of seeking revenge or retaliating with violence, the poet suggests that the best punishment is to do them an act of pure goodness (நன்னயம்). When they receive kindness in return for their malice, they will feel deeply ashamed (நாண) of their actions. Finally, one must simply let the matter go (விடல்) without harboring any lingering resentment.
